rows.grounds: instrumental plural expressing measure; internal sandhi ṣaṣ + aṃśaiḥ
genitive indicating the whole to which the part belongs

items.question: What shape and proportional measure must the back part of the altar assume?
premises: The back part of the altar is specified as the subject.
Its measure is defined as six parts.
The prescribed form for this part is that of a tortoise.
items.inference: The back part of the altar, measuring six parts, should be tortoise-shaped.
items.plain_english: The back part of the altar, measuring six parts, should be in the form of a tortoise.
